Dear Marco,

Thank you very much for your suggestion but I am afraid that this would
not do exactly the job.

Using return() will always return something even if no new object is
assigned.

invisible() should do it, i. e. plot the graph and return the result
only if a new object is assigned.

I used the same code in almost all other functions without any trouble...

Best

Jerome
